decisions.reason: Directly leverages the firm's core electrical and lighting component knowledge, enabling effective learning from early results.
LED luminaire builds on existing lighting and electrical know-how, so the firm can assimilate feedback and improve the product.
Home automation server box requires software and networking expertise distant from traditional electrical equipment, limiting absorptive capacity and ability to interpret early results.
As a luminaire family, it extends the core lighting portfolio and benefits from related design and manufacturing knowledge.
